d: Long, flowing jet black hair with straight-cut bangs frames a youthful face with sharp, narrow crimson eyes. The build is slender and athletic, wearing a beige military-style coat with gold epaulets and gold buttons over a white ruffled blouse and a short white pleated skirt, complemented by a red lining inside the coat. Signature details include a gold necklace with a green gem, blue and gold armbands, white gloves, and high dark-green boots with blue and gold trim and white lace cuffs.
